summary: Record the agreed application catalogue direction in Phase 10: a signed official Git repository plus community repositories fetched and verified by the pool master, one nex.yaml per application folder (a plain Compose file with an x-nex block, or kind: vm for appliances), a wizard-first install flow with an Advanced disclosure, and the no-Controller and Controller-replacement proofs. API impact: none for this planning change; the owning slice defines the catalogue-source, browse, install and update contracts on both sides.

guide.reason: Planning only; no operator workflow exists yet. The catalogue slice ships its guide pages with the implementation.

api.reason: No implemented client, Controller or Core contract changes. The plan names the future master-side catalogue-source, browse, install and update operations for the owning slice to define.

roadmap.reason: The later milestone gains the application catalogue as an agreed direction.

state.reason: Planning record. The design it records places catalogue sources, checkouts and application records on the pool master; the implementing slice declares that record.

verification.method: Docs-only change: scripts/check_docs.py --worktree, repository privacy unittest, and link review of the new plan anchor.
